{{Quote|The ground is ''mov''&mdash;no, it's a starship!''"<br />"''Wow! What a ''lousy'' place to ''park''!|Two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s|<ref name="The Collector" />}}
This '''abandoned planetoid''' was a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] went on a [[Mission to an abandoned planetoid|mission]] to this abandoned planetoid to investigate the source of a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]].
